'''Yogi We Have A Plan......Sort of (WHAP)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Yogi]]
* '''Published:''' 26 August 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We Have A Plan|Theed-L-wehaveaplan.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' We Have A Plan
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 We Have A Plan Yogi LS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

We Have a Plan deck made for some fun times and hopefully some winning time

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

Flip fast.

Hopefully you’ll get an Amidala and Panaka in your opening hand. Deploy them and then you can move to the Hallway, use Ascension Guns (can be pulled by Hallway) and you just need to draw a 1 and then they are at the Throne Room. You flip and let the direct damage flow.

Mace can hold a site by himself if you have an Are You Brain Dead in your hand otherwise put him and Panaka at the Courtyard. Amidala, Caldera Righim and Jerus Jannick should be at the Throne Room along with Sio and Horace. Put Obi Wan and Lando at the Hallway. Qui-gon can do the beatdown thing on a lone character or you can battle him against Maul if you are playing against Combat. He is also good at fortifing a location if you need it.

Card Choices:

Ascension Guns x2

If I am playing against Combat this is how the Locations go;

Throne Room

Generator

Generator core

Hallway

Courtyard

If they only have one Dark Jedi out at the Generator I put a Mace, Obi, or Qui at the Hallway. They move to the core to get after him. On my turn I use Ascension Guns to move him to the Throne Room. Now they have to deploy a Dark Jedi to Throne Room at deploy +4 (Goo and Celebration) or start moving back. Now that is like 4 turns where they can’t drain. That is just great.

Horace Vancil:

Put him at the Throne Room and start taking cards from their hand making them decide to lose a force or put it in their used pile. That is great!

Sio Bibble:

I can generate 2 more force at the Throne Room. My Republic characters gain a plus 1 power bonus at same site and My opponent drains for -1 at adjacent sites.

Panaka’s Blaster: Only have one but will be x2 when I get it

Obi Wan’s Lightsaber(Ep.1): Adds one when targeting a Dark Jedi

Strike Blocked: Combat tech

Alter(Ep.1): Senate Tech

Wesa Gotta Grand Army: Pull the Chambers

Are You Brain Dead: Mace can hold a site by himself and I don’t have to worry about battle damage

The Bith Shuffle/ Desperate Reach: I have a lot of people who track in my area

We Don’t Have Time For This: Only one cause Amidala and Panaka won’t be together very often

Free Ride/Endor Celebration: For those pesky Occupation cards

I have no matchups as of now because I haven’t played the deck yet. If you want a review just ask me and I will. Thanks for looking and hopefully helping.

Cards I would like to add:

Another Are You Brain Dead

Another Rebel Artillery

Maybe Yoda MOTF (I dunno, What do you think?)

If you have a suggestion on what to take out or if you have a suggestion on what to put in let me know in your review.
